Context: Newham, London, United Kingdom. Programme: Pension Credit (UK). Published figures held by HPI for this context and its wider geographies:
- Geography: Newham, London, United Kingdom (local authority). Additional income attributed by the council to supported Pension Credit claims (self-reported): 748,590 GBP (2024/25 council programme report; Newham Council).
- Geography: Newham, London, United Kingdom (local authority). Residents supported to claim Pension Credit by the council service (self-reported): 220 residents (2024/25 council programme report; Newham Council).
- Geography: Newham, London, United Kingdom (local authority). Income deprivation, residents aged 60+ (English Indices of Deprivation 2025): 46.7 percent (English Indices of Deprivation 2025 (underlying data years vary); Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government).
- Geography: Newham, London, United Kingdom (local authority). Income deprivation, all ages (English Indices of Deprivation 2025): 39 percent (English Indices of Deprivation 2025 (underlying data years vary); Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government).
- Geography: Newham, London, United Kingdom (local authority). Modelled caseload receipt rate: 78 percent (Financial year 2023/24; Department for Work and Pensions).
- Geography: Newham, London, United Kingdom (local authority). Households modelled as eligible for Pension Credit (all eligible): 11,300 households (Financial year 2023/24; Department for Work and Pensions).
- Geography: Newham, London, United Kingdom (local authority). Modelled expenditure receipt rate: 86 percent (Financial year 2023/24; Department for Work and Pensions).
- Geography: Newham, London, United Kingdom (local authority). Households modelled as potentially eligible but not in receipt: 2,500 households (Financial year 2023/24; Department for Work and Pensions).
- Geography: Newham, London, United Kingdom (local authority). Eligible households modelled as in receipt of Pension Credit: 8,800 households (Financial year 2023/24; Department for Work and Pensions).
- Geography: Great Britain (nation). National Pension Credit caseload take-up estimate: 62 percent (Financial year ending 2025; Department for Work and Pensions).
sources.dataClassBasis: HPI-composed list of figures already published with attribution on HPI context pages; per-figure redistribution status is recorded in research/platform/context-facts.json. Qualified licence review (G-03) remains open.
